copy_items.en: Change your email address
copy_items.af: Verander jou e-posadres

copy_items.en: Your current email address stays active until the new address is confirmed and the change is applied. Additional security checks may be required.
copy_items.af: Jou huidige e-posadres bly aktief totdat die nuwe adres bevestig en die verandering toegepas is. Bykomende sekuriteitskontroles kan nodig wees.

copy_items.en: Current email address
copy_items.af: Huidige e-posadres

copy_items.en: New email address
copy_items.af: Nuwe e-posadres

copy_items.en: For your security, confirm your identity before requesting this change.
copy_items.af: Vir jou veiligheid, bevestig jou identiteit voordat jy hierdie verandering versoek.

copy_items.en: Request email change
copy_items.af: Versoek e-posadresverandering

copy_items.en: If the request can proceed, you will need to confirm your new email address. Your current email address has not changed.
copy_items.af: As die versoek kan voortgaan, sal jy jou nuwe e-posadres moet bevestig. Jou huidige e-posadres het nie verander nie.

copy_items.en: Check your new email address
copy_items.af: Gaan jou nuwe e-posadres na

copy_items.en: If a confirmation email is sent, use its link to confirm the new address. Confirmation alone does not change your account email.
copy_items.af: As ’n bevestigings-e-pos gestuur word, gebruik die skakel daarin om die nuwe adres te bevestig. Bevestiging alleen verander nie jou rekening se e-posadres nie.

copy_items.en: Confirm your new email address
copy_items.af: Bevestig jou nuwe e-posadres

copy_items.en: Confirm that you can access this address. Your current email stays in place until the change is applied.
copy_items.af: Bevestig dat jy toegang tot hierdie adres het. Jou huidige e-posadres bly aktief totdat die verandering toegepas word.

copy_items.en: Confirm new email
copy_items.af: Bevestig nuwe e-posadres

copy_items.en: New email address confirmed
copy_items.af: Nuwe e-posadres bevestig

copy_items.en: Your current email remains active until the account change is applied.
copy_items.af: Jou huidige e-posadres bly aktief totdat die rekeningverandering toegepas word.

copy_items.en: Additional security checks are in progress
copy_items.af: Bykomende sekuriteitskontroles is aan die gang

copy_items.en: Your new address has been confirmed, but the change has not been applied. Keep using your current email address until the security checks are complete.
copy_items.af: Jou nuwe adres is bevestig, maar die verandering is nog nie toegepas nie. Gebruik intussen jou huidige e-posadres totdat die sekuriteitskontroles afgehandel is.

copy_items.en: Email address changed
copy_items.af: E-posadres verander

copy_items.en: Your new email address is now the primary address for your account. Sign in again if prompted.
copy_items.af: Jou nuwe e-posadres is nou jou rekening se primêre e-posadres. Meld weer aan as jy gevra word.

copy_items.en: We could not confirm the current status
copy_items.af: Ons kon nie die huidige status bevestig nie

copy_items.en: Sign in and check your account email address before you try again.
copy_items.af: Meld aan en gaan jou rekening se e-posadres na voordat jy weer probeer.

copy_items.en: This confirmation is unavailable
copy_items.af: Hierdie bevestiging is nie beskikbaar nie

copy_items.en: The link may have expired or been replaced. Sign in to start a new email change.
copy_items.af: Die skakel het dalk verval of is vervang. Meld aan om 'n nuwe e-posverandering te begin.

copy_items.en: Cancel email change
copy_items.af: Kanselleer e-posadresverandering

copy_items.en: Email change cancelled
copy_items.af: E-posadresverandering gekanselleer
